newsitem.title: CHINA: Yitai Coal to issue 166 mln B shares at $0.4073.
newsitem.headline: Yitai Coal to issue 166 mln B shares at $0.4073.

text.p: Inner Mongolia Yitai Coal Co Ltd will issue 166 million foreign currency B shares at 3.377 yuan ($0.4073) each in Shanghai on Friday, the company's prospectus said.
The issue would raise a net income of 524.144 million yuan excluding an issue cost of 36.438 million yuan, the prospectus published in the Shanghai Securities News on Friday said.

Proceeds would mainly be used to improve the transportation system of the coal firm's various production bases in China's remote northern Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region and build a new base there, the prospectus said.
The company had appointed China Guotai Securities as the lead domestic underwriter and Jardine Fleming Holdings Limited as international coordinator, it said.
After the B share issue, the company would have 366 million outstanding shares with the B shares accounting for 45.36 percent and the remaining shares owned by the state, it said.
In 1996, the firm posted net profit of 71.41 million yuan against 51.13 million yuan in 1995 based on international accounting standards, the prospect said.

Yitai Coal forecast 1997 net profit would increase more than 70 percent mainly due to the firm's rich resources, improved transportation system, a good market for its high-quality coal products and a strong management team, it said.
